sharedFileOwnership.rule: Design section 13: within each wave writePaths are disjoint and every sharedPaths list is empty. Each plan owns every exact-count or inventory test its change breaks. Workers run in the same working directory and do not commit; a later wave sees the earlier waves' uncommitted changes. Files outside a plan's writePaths are read-only; a defect there is a Reconciliation request in the plan Progress Log naming the owning plan.

reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput:telescreen-v1.4-data-inventory (Telescreen v1.4: data inventory; workflowExecutionId opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-15; plans accepted by step5-impl-plan-review in comm-000749)
reviewContext.userProblem: The owner asked (translated) whether Telescreen holds a data management list of where data lives and its audit history (when added, when deleted). It does not (requirements section 1, re-verified in design section 1). v1.4 adds a data asset register with append-only lifecycle events, list-item change tracking, an admin-defined metadata field schema with required flags and validated values, retention overdue handling, a Data UI area and a masked CSV export.
requiredOutcomes: R1-R3: data_assets register (DATA-n) discovered from every scan path per collector inventory_mode (sensitive_only, all, off) or registered manually; deletion and restoration only from definitive removal signals and the SUCCEEDED-sweep and full-listing reconciliations; manual mark deleted and restore.

R4: item keys or counts on the collector port, push ingest (additive) and police contract 1.2; item keys HMAC'd on receipt (Fingerprinter.item_key, separate domain label); finding-fingerprint value diffs for every asset; manual partial-change events.

R5-R6: admin field schema (types, options, required, order, archive, roles purpose/owner/deletion_due, immutable keys, type change only without values); validated values; incomplete flag; metadata_changed events and audit; values with detected secrets rejected 422 without echo.
R7: overdue tab, dashboard tile and one owner notification per due date (system.data_overdue).

R8-R9: Data UI (list with tabs and counts, filters, detail, metadata form, timeline, item-count chart, items, related issues), schema editor, registration, issue-to-asset link, masked CSV export; every member write audited; events append-only (PostgreSQL trigger).
Diagra document changed first, exports regenerated, models and exactly one Alembic revision 0005_v1_4 match; mise run ddl-check passes.

Every new route declares exactly one permission (22 routes, test_route_permissions_v14.py); leak flows 1-7 cover assets, events, items, field values, export and overdue notifications; E2E E1-E7 pass offline.

mise run ci passes offline; src/web typecheck, vitest, build and strict screenshots (0 state-skipped, 0 browser errors, light and dark) pass; README v1.4 features, design status lines and impl-plans index updated; v14 plans archived.
nonGoals: Requirements section 5: data lineage, classification beyond existing detectors, deletion execution, per-item metadata, versioned field schemas.
No Meilisearch indexing of assets (D21); no new notification category (D18); no LLM detector for metadata (D14).
No fix of the C5 custom push identity mismatch (pending owner decision).
No dependency change; no edit of Alembic 0001-0004; no weakening of tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH or ty strictness; no per-file-ignore entries.
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis; plan files under 400 lines; every Python file under 1000 lines (issues/service.py split via issues/external_scan.py; v1.4 wiring in wiring_v14.py).
Strict typing (no Any, object, dict or **kwargs; dataclasses or enums; no type-ignore).
Raw detected values, raw item keys and source content are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified, exported or returned; only masked text, 12-hex prefixes and keyed HMAC fingerprints.
Telescreen stays read-only on sources; lifecycle events append-only; incomplete or failed scans never infer deletion or item removal.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration and live tests skip without TELESCREEN_TEST_* and are never listed as verification.

Conventions 2, 7 and 7a: write only inside writePaths; per-edit fresh read and pre/post SHA-256 in the Progress Log; fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands.
Workers never run git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add/push; only the serial finalization commits and pushes to feat/data-inventory.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: new L3 package telescreen.inventory owns the five tables; API prefix /api/data; UI label Data.
D2: one asset per resource_key (issue identity); registered assets use resource_key('registered:' + source, locator); UNIQUE(resource_key) makes a duplicate registration 409.
D3/D8: collector_configs.inventory_mode column; switching to off turns present discovered assets unknown (tracking_stopped) and turning it back on resumes (tracking_resumed).

D4-D6/D11: any non-removed observation proves presence; removal only from removed observations and the SUCCEEDED-sweep and full-listing reconciliations (only when no listed ref was skipped); additions on every observation, removals and count changes only on complete ones.
D10: item_fingerprint = HMAC(HMAC(identity key v1, 'telescreen:data-item:v1'), resource_key + NUL + raw key); stable across key rotation; only 12-hex prefixes leave the Bureau.
D12: value diffs over finding fingerprints with a silent re-baseline on key-version change.
D15-D17: incomplete and overdue computed in SQL; overdue_notified_for stores the notified due date so a changed date notifies again.
D22: no literal segment under /api/data/assets/ (counts, export and resource-assets lookup live elsewhere) to avoid route capture.
D23: event repository is insert-only; PostgreSQL trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE on data_asset_events.
C3: push ingest has no JSON Schema, so only the police contract is versioned (1.2); ingest v1 bodies get additive optional members.

Read paths resolve owners with ActorDirectory.display, never RecipientResolver.assignee_of (unmapped RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN would be 500); writes map RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN to unknown_reference / 422; the overdue handler falls back to fallback_owner.
intentionalTradeoffs: C5 identity mismatch is kept: one locator pushed via /scan and /findings becomes two assets until the owner decides.
Item diffs accept up to 100000 keys per complete observation (push) and 10000 fingerprints per police inventory; performance is a residual risk.
Strict screenshot state issue-data-link has no action, so the asset link render is proven by the p06 vitest (pages/issues/IssueDetail.test.tsx), not the screenshot run.
Wave-1 and wave-2 plans treat the full pytest suite as informational because parallel siblings are mid-change; p07 and p08 require it to pass.
p04/p07 routers stay unregistered until p08 wires them, so route-walk proof comes only in wave 4.
supportedEdgeCases: A removed observation for an unknown or already deleted asset is a no-op.
Out-of-order observations never move last_seen_at backwards.
A previously removed item is reopened, never re-inserted (unique constraint).
Discovered asset name only changes from a non-empty scan title; empty-title creation uses display_locator.
Deactivated-member or deleted-team owners give 200 on list, detail and export; overdue handler falls back and still marks and audits.
A per-asset send failure in the overdue run rolls back only that asset; the keyset cursor guarantees termination and each asset is attempted once per run.
Concurrent registration race (IntegrityError after pre-check) returns 409, not 500.
GET /api/data/resource-assets/{key} returns {asset: null} with 200 when absent; 422 unless 64 lowercase hex.
CSV cells starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR are prefixed with a quote; at most 10000 rows with X-Telescreen-Truncated.
Police 1.0 and 1.1 envelopes still validate; old ingest payloads keep their response shape.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live runs against Keycloak, Mailpit, Slack or PostgreSQL in default CI (owner-only, TELESCREEN_TEST_* variables).
Per-item metadata, lineage between assets and versioned field schemas (requirements section 5).
